INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY=Source/static reconstruction plus deterministic presentation-gate model; no production Git writes and no physical Fold7 claims.
CHEAPEST_DECISIVE_FIRST_ACTION=Locate current-main presentation/mirror/wallpaper ownership and determine whether any existing signal actually proves first-useful inner presentation before continuity release.
EXPECTED_ARTIFACT=Manager handoff with current-source map, dominant gap, second-generation gate design, deterministic model/validator and integration touchpoints.
